title: Building a voxel colony sim with Codex: StoneEra’s free Steam demo is live
author: Arrock12
selftext:
I’m building StoneEra solo in Unity, with Codex helping on coding and the development workflow. The free Steam demo is now live.



StoneEra is a voxel colony sandbox where you reshape terrain, plan buildings, grow food and assign villagers work. Villagers carry resources in physical crates, and you can dig channels and build waterworks to control flowing water.



A concrete example of the AI workflow is this release. Codex helped prepare the demo build and automate fresh footage captures in Unity Play Mode, then helped edit the video and add captions using Python and FFmpeg.



I keep the work in small steps: a specific task, a focused change, then checks for that change. Compilation, behavior in Unity and the packaged build each need their own verification, especially when villagers, construction, cargo and water interact.



The video shows the menu, skins, world creation and colony systems. Maps reach 1024 × 1024 blocks, with Classic V7 and Experimental V8 available. V8 is still in development; V7 is recommended.



The demo has a one-hour session limit:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/)



For others using coding agents in games: what checks have been most useful for catching problems when several gameplay systems interact?
